recommendations.title: Start protective irrigation
recommendations.detail: Give light irrigation in the cooler part of the day and avoid flooding the root zone.

recommendations.title: Reduce soil moisture loss
recommendations.detail: Use mulch or crop residue around plants to slow evaporation from the top soil.

recommendations.title: Check field cracks
recommendations.detail: If cracks are widening, prioritize that plot for water or community irrigation support.

recommendations.title: Open drainage channels
recommendations.detail: Create shallow side channels so extra water can leave the plot within 24 hours.

recommendations.title: Avoid more irrigation
recommendations.detail: Pause irrigation until the top soil starts drying and roots get air again.

recommendations.title: Watch root health
recommendations.detail: Uproot one weak plant and check for black, soft, or foul-smelling roots.

recommendations.title: Scout the underside of leaves
recommendations.detail: Check 10 random plants for larvae, egg clusters, and fresh feeding marks.

recommendations.title: Use traps or manual removal
recommendations.detail: Install pheromone or yellow sticky traps where suitable and remove visible egg masses.

recommendations.title: Escalate only if threshold is crossed
recommendations.detail: Use pesticide only after local advisory confirms the pest level is above economic threshold.

recommendations.title: Remove infected leaves
recommendations.detail: Take out heavily infected leaves from the field edge first and keep them away from compost.

recommendations.title: Improve air movement
recommendations.detail: Remove dense weeds and avoid unnecessary evening irrigation that keeps leaves wet overnight.

recommendations.title: Confirm before spraying
recommendations.detail: Match the spot pattern with a local extension worker before choosing a fungicide.

recommendations.title: Irrigate before peak heat
recommendations.detail: Water early morning or evening so the crop can handle afternoon temperature spikes.

recommendations.title: Protect flowering stage
recommendations.detail: If the crop is flowering, keep moisture steady because heat can reduce pollination.

recommendations.title: Use temporary shade where practical
recommendations.detail: For nursery or vegetable plots, use shade netting during extreme hot afternoons.

recommendations.title: Check nutrient pattern
recommendations.detail: Older yellow leaves often indicate nitrogen stress, while purpling may point to phosphorus stress.

recommendations.title: Maintain root-zone moisture
recommendations.detail: Nutrients move poorly in very dry soil, so correct moisture before expecting fertilizer response.

recommendations.title: Apply balanced nutrition
recommendations.detail: Use soil-test guidance where available and avoid applying only one nutrient repeatedly.
